game.label: Your disc image (.iso or .ciso) of the USA GameCube release, GF7E01.

prepare.label: Recompiling the game from your disc. The first time downloads about 280 MB of build tools and can take 20 minutes or more.

exit_codes.3: The game hasn't been built from your disc yet. Run its setup again on the game's page.
exit_codes.4: The game was built from a different copy of the disc. Run its setup again on the game's page.
exit_codes.5: It couldn't find your copy of the game. Pick it again on the game's page.
exit_codes.6: The game is already running, from here or from Peregrine Forge. Close it first, then start it again.

looks.reason: The game starts through its own launcher, so looks can't attach to it. Use its Anti-aliasing and Output filter settings instead.

settings.label: Resolution
settings.help: What the game draws at. 1x is the GameCube's own 480 lines; higher sharpens edges but keeps the original textures.

settings.label: Aspect ratio
settings.help: 4:3 is the picture as designed. 16:9 is experimental: some objects at the edges can pop in late. F8 switches during play.

settings.label: Window
settings.help: Big Picture mode always starts full screen. Alt+Enter switches during play.

settings.label: V-Sync
settings.help: Waits for your screen's refresh to stop tearing.

settings.label: Anti-aliasing
settings.help: FXAA smooths jagged edges but softens text a little.

settings.label: Output filter
settings.help: How the picture is fitted to your window. Sharp keeps text crisp.

settings.label: Texture filtering
settings.help: Keeps ground and walls sharp at shallow angles. Costs very little.

settings.label: Trilinear mipmaps
settings.help: Blends between texture detail levels so distant surfaces don't shimmer.

settings.label: Soft particles
settings.help: Smoke and explosions fade where they meet the ground instead of cutting off. Can dim some glow effects.

settings.label: Music
settings.help: Mutes the streamed music and keeps the sound effects.

settings.label: Stick deadzone
settings.help: How far a stick moves before the game notices. Raise it if your ship drifts.

actions.label: Save backups
actions.help: Backups made by the Peregrine Forge launcher.

actions.label: Logs
actions.help: A log for each session, for bug reports.
